name: Snow Day!
story: School is closed for snow, and BOLT's sledge is locked in the garage. Free it before the snow melts!

hints: Look for a row, column or box that already has three numbers. The fourth is easy!
The first ★ square holds 1.

d.intro: Fill the grid so every row, every column and every 2-by-2 box has the numbers 1, 2, 3 and 4. The code is the numbers in the ★ squares, reading left to right, top to bottom.

hints: Count the dark cards in each row. Which row has an odd number?
The odd row is row F. Now check the columns.

d.intro: A magician laid out these cards so every row and every column had an even number of dark cards. Then one card was secretly flipped! Find it. The code is its row letter and column number, like B4.

hints: Write the row out again after every swap so you don't lose track.
After the first full pass the row is 1, 5, 4, 7.

d.intro: Bubble sort walks along the row comparing neighbours. If the left number is bigger, they swap. Keep making passes until the row goes from smallest to biggest. The code is the total number of swaps.

hints: Look at the gaps between each number and the next.
The gaps are 4, 4, 4, 4. What comes next?

d.intro: Find the pattern in the numbers. The code is the next two numbers, one after the other.

final.title: The Snowdrift Lock
hints: Read the clue again and try different orders out loud. It has 4 letters.
It starts with C and ends with N.
final.done: Lock open! Snow Day! complete. BOLT's screen says BRRR!

name: Battle of the Bands
story: BOLT's band is about to play, but the amplifier is code-locked. Rock on!

hints: Use the alphabet strip: the small numbers show each letter's place.
2 is the letter B.

d.intro: Each number is a letter's place in the alphabet: A = 1, B = 2 ... Z = 26. Turn the numbers into letters to find the code word.

hints: Try working backwards from the flag. Dead ends are easier to spot that way.
The first letter on the route is S.

d.intro: Guide the robot from the star to the flag. There's only one way through. Collect the letters on your route, in order. Tap squares to mark your path.

hints: Count round the clock face. After 12 comes 1 again.
After the first move it is 3 o'clock.

d.intro: BOLT's clock only goes from 1 to 12. Start at 12 o'clock and follow each move: + means hours later, − means hours earlier. Write the time after every move. The code is all the times, one after the other.

hints: Look at the gaps between each number and the next.
The gaps are 5, 5, 5, 5. What comes next?

d.intro: Find the pattern in the numbers. The code is the next two numbers, one after the other.

final.title: The Tuning Fork Lock
hints: Read the clue again and try different orders out loud. It has 4 letters.
It starts with N and ends with E.
final.done: Lock open! Battle of the Bands complete. BOLT's screen says LA LA!

name: Campfire Night
story: BOLT is packing for a campfire night, but the marshmallow tin is locked. That will never do!

hints: Match each symbol's shape to the key. Look carefully for a dot!
The first symbol is H.
Work upwards: add each pair of neighbours in the bottom row.
The top brick is 53.

d.intro: Each brick is the sum of the two bricks underneath it. Work out the missing bricks. The code is the numbers on the ★ bricks, top brick first.

hints: Start with any clue that tells you exactly where someone stands.
NOA ends up in space 1.

d.intro: 4 friends, TEVA, KOA, ISLA and NOA, line up in spaces 1 to 4. Use the clues to work out the order. The code is the first letter of each name, from space 1 to space 4.
clues: KOA stands directly to the right of ISLA.
NOA stands somewhere to the left of TEVA.

hints: A REPEAT block runs everything indented under it that many times.
If a REPEAT is inside another REPEAT, multiply: 3 times round the outside and 2 inside means 6.

final.title: The Volcano Lock
final.clue: It lights up a dark room.
hints: Read the clue again and try different orders out loud. It has 4 letters.
It starts with L and ends with P.
final.done: Lock open! Campfire Night complete. BOLT's screen says HOT!!

name: Beach Clean-Up Day
story: BOLT's beach-cleaning machine has scrambled its settings. Fix it before the tide comes in!

hints: Start with rows or columns whose numbers fill most of the line, like a 5 in a column.
Row 1 looks like this: ■□■□■□■

d.intro: Shade squares to make a picture. The numbers by each row and column say how many shaded squares come together in a block, in order. The finished picture shows a two-digit code.

hints: Match each symbol's shape to the key. Look carefully for a dot!
The first symbol is B.
Each group of dots and dashes is one letter. Find it in the key.
The first letter is E.
Look for a row, column or box that already has three numbers. The fourth is easy!
The first ★ square holds 2.

d.intro: Fill the grid so every row, every column and every 2-by-2 box has the numbers 1, 2, 3 and 4. The code is the numbers in the ★ squares, reading left to right, top to bottom.

final.title: The Porthole Lock
final.clue: A white drink that comes from cows.
hints: Read the clue again and try different orders out loud. It has 4 letters.
It starts with M and ends with K.
final.done: Lock open! Beach Clean-Up Day complete. BOLT's screen says DIVE!

name: Pizza Oven Panic
story: The lab's pizza oven has locked itself with pizzas inside. Unlock it before they burn!

hints: Start with any clue that tells you exactly where someone stands.
TEVA ends up in space 1.

d.intro: 4 friends, KOA, TEVA, RAFE and NOA, line up in spaces 1 to 4. Use the clues to work out the order. The code is the first letter of each name, from space 1 to space 4.
clues: NOA stands directly to the right of RAFE.
KOA and RAFE stand next to each other.

hints: Work from the right-hand column to the left, just like normal adding.
The right-hand column is 0 + 1 = 1, so write 1.

d.intro: Add the two binary numbers, starting from the right. Remember 1 + 1 = 10: write 0 and carry 1. The code is the answer in binary, with 4 digits.

hints: Work upwards: add each pair of neighbours in the bottom row.
The top brick is 49.

d.intro: Each brick is the sum of the two bricks underneath it. Work out the missing bricks. The code is the numbers on the ★ bricks, top brick first.

hints: Start with the guess that scored the most ●. Which of its digits could be right?
The first digit of the code is 1.

d.intro: BOLT's safe has a 3-digit code made from the digits 1 to 6, with no digit used twice. For each guess, ● means a right digit in the right place and ○ means a right digit in the wrong place. Work out the code.

final.title: The Rock Lab Lock
hints: Read the clue again and try different orders out loud. It has 4 letters.
It starts with F and ends with T.
final.done: Lock open! Pizza Oven Panic complete. BOLT's screen says HOT!!

name: Weekend Boss: The Talent Show
story: The talent show curtain won't open because its control panel is scrambled. The audience is waiting!

hints: Cross off each word in the list as you find it.
The first leftover letter is T.

d.intro: Find every word in the list. Words go across, down and diagonally. Tap letters to mark them. The letters left over, read from left to right and top to bottom, spell the code.

hints: Look at the gaps between each number and the next.
The gaps are 4, 6, 8, 10. What comes next?

d.intro: Find the pattern in the numbers. The code is the next two numbers, one after the other.

hints: Draw the pile (or the line) and cross letters out as they leave.
The first letter to leave is X.

d.intro: A stack is like a pile of crates: PUSH puts a crate on top and POP takes the top crate off. Write down the letter on every crate you POP, in order. That's the code.

hints: Work through the bridges from left to right, one at a time, rewriting the column of numbers.
At the first bridge, 9 and 8 meet: 8 goes up.

d.intro: Numbers travel along the wires from left to right. At each bridge the two numbers compare: the smaller one goes to the upper wire and the bigger one to the lower wire. The code is the numbers coming out on the right, top to bottom.

hints: Keep track of which way the rover is facing. A turn doesn't move it.
The first Forward move lands on B.

d.intro: The rover starts on the star, facing UP. 'Turn right' and 'Turn left' spin it on the spot without moving. Write down the letter after every Forward move.

final.title: The Mixer Lock
final.clue: A flat piece you play games on.
hints: Read the clue again and try different orders out loud. It has 5 letters.
It starts with B and ends with D.
final.done: Lock open! Weekend Boss: The Talent Show complete. BOLT's screen says LA LA!

name: The Treasure Map
story: BOLT found an old map in the library with a locked compass box attached. Follow the clues!

hints: Try working backwards from the flag. Dead ends are easier to spot that way.
The first letter on the route is K.

d.intro: Guide the robot from the star to the flag. There's only one way through. Collect the letters on your route, in order. Tap squares to mark your path.

hints: Work through the bridges from left to right, one at a time, rewriting the column of numbers.
At the first bridge, 5 and 3 meet: 3 goes up.

d.intro: Numbers travel along the wires from left to right. At each bridge the two numbers compare: the smaller one goes to the upper wire and the bigger one to the lower wire. The code is the numbers coming out on the right, top to bottom.

hints: Draw the pile (or the line) and cross letters out as they leave.
The first letter to leave is X.

d.intro: A stack is like a pile of crates: PUSH puts a crate on top and POP takes the top crate off. Write down the letter on every crate you POP, in order. That's the code.

hints: Work upwards: add each pair of neighbours in the bottom row.
The top brick is 26.

d.intro: Each brick is the sum of the two bricks underneath it. Work out the missing bricks. The code is the numbers on the ★ bricks, top brick first.

final.title: The Temple Lock
final.clue: Code that repeats again and again.
hints: Read the clue again and try different orders out loud. It has 4 letters.
It starts with L and ends with P.
final.done: Lock open! The Treasure Map complete. BOLT's screen says SANDY
